test_cases.name: product_models
evaluation_criteria: Generate a ProductModel interface with name (string), price (number), description (optional string), category (string), inStock (optional boolean), tags (optional string[])
Generate a ProductService class with createProduct method
Service method should use proper generic type parameter
All imports should use .js extensions

test_cases.name: product_list_models
evaluation_criteria: Generate a ProductService with listProducts method accepting query parameters
Generate response model with products array, total, page, limit fields
Properly type the product items in the array

test_cases.name: order_models_nested
evaluation_criteria: Generate OrderModel with nested items array (OrderItemModel type)
Generate ShippingAddress interface as a nested object type
Generate OrderService with createOrder method
Properly type status as enum or string literal union
Handle datetime (createdAt) as string type

test_cases.name: order_get_models
evaluation_criteria: Generate OrderService with getOrderById method taking orderId parameter
Response type should include nested items array and shippingAddress
Path parameter should be properly typed as string

test_cases.name: payment_models_nested_resource
evaluation_criteria: Generate PaymentModel with amount (number), currency (enum), method (enum)
Generate PaymentService with createPayment method taking orderId and payment
Enum values should be properly typed (USD/EUR/GBP for currency)
Service method path should include /orders/{orderId}/payments

test_cases.name: search_models
evaluation_criteria: Generate ProductService with searchProducts method
Method should accept query string and optional sort parameter
Response model should include results array, total, and query fields

test_cases.name: product_array_boolean_types
evaluation_criteria: tags field should be typed as string[] or Array<string>
inStock field should be typed as boolean
price field should be typed as number
Optional fields should use ? syntax or be marked as optional
